rules: Never reset a linked, remote, staging, or production database.
Never drop or truncate existing database objects or production data.
Reuse authoritative Tourify systems and link to them instead of duplicating data.
Use feature flags and forward corrective migrations for rollback.

blocking_decisions.resolution: Audit current payment code and configuration.
Business/legal/finance approval required before native checkout launch.
Document owner and system behavior before payment phase.
Confirm before seller onboarding and checkout activation.

phases.name: Repository and system audit
phases.gate: No implementation until ownership, payments, profile, feed, ticket, music, and schema integration maps are approved.

global_completion_requirements: All permitted and prohibited account/listing combinations have server-side tests.
Native, external, ticket, fixed service, booking, quote, profile, and feed flows pass.
All new exposed tables have reviewed grants and RLS.
Payment webhook processing is signed and idempotent.
Guest order access is opaque, expiring, and non-enumerable.
Existing profile, feed, ticket, music, auth, account, notification, messaging, calendar, file, admin, and finance tests pass.
Production migration dry run contains only expected additive changes.
Feature-disable rollback is verified without deleting data.
Every task status includes evidence before it is marked complete.
